$comment: Folder-level ownership for the P3 lanes (BUILD_OUTLINE.md sections 1 and 3). A path is owned by the lane whose `owns` prefix matches it and whose `except` list does not; a prefix ending in / is a folder, anything else is one file. `everyLane` paths any lane may edit (state, decisions, security items, review files, the README). `shared` maps a file to the lanes that each own a section in it, marked `# [lane-P3a]`, `// [lane-P3a]` or `<!-- [lane-P3a] -->`. `noLane` paths no lane edits; changes there go under Requests for integration and P4 applies them. `uncollected` lists test-file patterns a runner would never collect. Written in P2; only P2 and P4 edit it. The template's lanes own nothing until P2 fills them.

uncollected.why: pytest collects only test_*.py; a helper module goes in the lane's src folder or in conftest.py
